findings.title: Architectural discipline holds across all 98 commits
findings.evidence: git diff --stat ec0d49241..HEAD on every member of §7 FROZEN ZONES returns ZERO lines. The single Fiscal/* delta is a NEW companion service (ZReportCashEnrichmentService.php, 320 LOC) composed on top of the frozen ZReportService, not modifying it. The new POS Loyalty path (PosLoyaltyController + PosLoyaltyRedeemModal.vue + PosLoyaltyRedeemRequest + PosRedemptionService) is a fresh feature branch sitting beside the historically-dirty PosController — explicit decision per LOCK plan §3 Option B (commit 90c9c0ee5).

findings.title: Layered repair pattern (route + middleware + config) consistently applied
findings.evidence: Three idempotency heals (commit 4b12f678a + commit 933af3d2e + commit ab04839ec siblings) all follow the same triplet: (1) route declares `idempotency` middleware, (2) config/idempotency.php required_routes adds the URI pattern, (3) sentinel `IdempotencyRequiredRoutesCoverageTest` enforces the two stay in sync. This is exactly the contract the C-P0-H heal codified.

findings.title: Config-route sync drift: NEW POS loyalty redeem route bypassed required_routes
findings.evidence: commit 90c9c0ee5 + 4d2dd0342 wired `idempotency` middleware on routes/api.php:920 `POST /api/admin/pos-order/{order}/redeem-loyalty` but did not add the wildcard `api/admin/pos-order/*/redeem-loyalty` to config/idempotency.php required_routes. The sentinel IdempotencyRequiredRoutesCoverageTest correctly surfaces this: 1 fail, 'Routes with `idempotency` middleware NOT in config(idempotency.required_routes)'. Sentinel is doing exactly its job. Risk magnitude: low (middleware idempotency is opt-in by config — missing entry means the middleware is silently no-op, not unsafe — but a network retry could double-debit loyalty balance because client side IS sending Idempotency-Key headers).
findings.recommendation: 1-line config heal: add `'api/admin/pos-order/*/redeem-loyalty'` to required_routes array. Pre-existing sister entry `api/frontend/loyalty/redeem` (line 73) sets the precedent. Defer to follow-up commit; not a session regression in code, just a missing config wire.

findings.title: Service composition discipline on the NF525 perimeter
findings.evidence: ZReportCashEnrichmentService.php composes ZReportService but does NOT subclass or extend it — preserves §7 frozen-zone read-only contract on ZReportService. Wire-up sentinel ZReportCashEnrichmentSentinelTest GREEN. Same pattern on Loyalty: LoyaltyQrSigner is a new utility under app/Services/Loyalty/, LoyaltyController scan() calls it without subclassing. This avoids the historical pattern of extending sealed services and inheriting unwanted behavior.

findings.title: PosController remains DIRTY per LOCK plan; future P0s likely still localized there
findings.evidence: commit 4d2dd0342 explicitly comments 'PosController.php is DIRTY — observe-only'. The Loyalty redemption flow goes through a NEW controller (PosLoyaltyController). This is a correct short-term decision but leaves the larger refactor in the V1.0.X backlog. Risk: any future loyalty-adjacent feature must remember to NOT touch PosController; coupling could re-emerge silently. Document the rationale in PROJECT_BRAIN.md §7 to lock-in the convention.
